notes.title: ‼️PATCH UPDATE: Foodomina Demo v1.1‼️✨️🍰
notes.notes:
ᯓ✦ Hello Gamers! We hope you've been enjoying the demo!


We've got some new updates ready to play that make it even better! This is our first of many demo updates we have planned, so grab your snacks and take a read at what's changed! 🍿✨️



୧ ‧₊˚ NEW FEATURES:

 ▪︎ New Dialogue Animations

▪︎ Sneak peak of new content in development at the END

▪︎ Ability to pat Tempura 

▪︎ Setting to disable Battle Timers 

▪︎ Setting to highlight or colour code Cure Hints 



୧ ‧₊˚ CHANGELOG:

▪︎ General Bug Fixes 

▪︎ Fixed some typos & sentence structures

▪︎ Dialogue UI Overhaul for New Animations 

▪︎ Updated visuals & VFX for improved UX in battles

▪︎ All game testers from last year (2024) who provided their names have been included in the game credits
